# Build-free CI dependencies for the TylerPilot fork (pip-only).
#
# The fork currently ships no build system (root SConstruct missing), so the CI
# Python jobs run a build-free subset and need only:
#   - the linters, and
#   - the pip-resolvable imports pulled in by the pure-Python test subset and the
#     TylerPilot modules (`openpilot.system.hardware` -> cereal/pycapnp, etc.).
#
# Versions mirror uv.lock so CI matches the lockfile.

codespell==2.4.2
pytest==9.0.3
pytest-mock==3.15.1
pycapnp==2.1.0
zstandard==0.25.0
numpy==2.4.6
pyserial==3.5
spidev==3.8
pyzmq==27.1.0
psutil==7.2.2
requests==2.34.2
tqdm==4.68.1
